title: Relief Against a Granite Ridge Restoration Charge for Refusals Recorded as an Expired Card
content:
Where the refusals that took a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass out of scanning were recorded by the payment method as the card having expired, and the pass account has since been paid, part of the restoration charge is relieved.

**First.** Where the pass account carries at least as many refusals recorded as the card having expired in the three whole months ending on the handling date as the number of refusals the tier tolerates before privileges are reviewed, and a scheduled instalment has cleared later than the most recent refusal, a quarter of the charge is relieved, a rate of 25 per cent.

**Second.** Where the pass account carries at least 1 refusal recorded as the card having expired in the three whole months ending on the handling date, fewer than the number the tier tolerates, and a scheduled instalment has cleared later than the most recent refusal, a tenth of the charge is relieved, a rate of 10 per cent.

**Otherwise.** In any other case no relief is given on this head.

### Both conditions are compound

| Refusals recorded as the card having expired, in the three whole months ending on the handling date | A scheduled instalment cleared later than the most recent refusal | Rate relieved |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least the tier's tolerance | yes | 25 per cent |
| at least the tier's tolerance | no | none on this head |
| at least 1 but below the tier's tolerance | yes | 10 per cent |
| at least 1 but below the tier's tolerance | no | none on this head |
| none | either | none on this head |

The refusal counted here is only the one the payment method recorded as the card having expired; refusals recorded for any other reason are not counted on this head. The cleared instalment must be dated later than the most recent refusal standing on the account, whatever the reason recorded against that refusal.

### Worked on a hypothetical account

A Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass tolerates 4 refusals. The pass account shows 2 refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date, of which 1 is recorded as the card having expired, and a scheduled instalment cleared later than both of them. One refusal recorded as the card having expired is at least 1 and stands below the tolerance of 4, so the second condition is met and a tenth of the charge is relieved. Where no scheduled instalment had cleared later than the most recent refusal, no relief would be given on this head however those refusals were recorded.
